programme.desc: Uhonorowana nagrodą Emmy seria przyrodnicza ukazująca podwodny świat. Gospodarz programu, Jonathan Bird to amerykański filmowiec i fotograf specjalizujący się w zdjęciach podwodnych. programme.desc: «Robinson Report (7): From Conchi Amancio to Conchi Maradona» 50 years ago the first women's football match was played in Spain. It happened in Madrid and the match ended with a result of five goals to one in favor of Sizam, a team led by a 13-year-old teenager named Conchi Sánchez. Hers were the five goals for which from that day on she became known as Conchi Amancio. She thus became the highest representative of a group of pioneers who fought to develop a sport for which their country was not prepared. That is why at the age of 15 he would make the decision to change scene and develop his career in a much more established championship like the Italian one. After 23 years in football, and after winning 8 Scudettos and 7 Italian Cups, Conchi left her host country renamed Conchi Maradona.

programme.title: Robinson Report (S7): From Conchi Amancio to Conchi Maradona
programme.desc: «Matchday 32: Villarreal – Celta» A Villarreal CF – Celta de Vigo is synonymous with goals and spectacle. programme.desc: «90 years of LaLiga (2019): Miquel Soler» With his career Miquel Soler placed his hometown, Hostalets de'n Bas, on the football map. Left-handed defender is the player with the most seasons in Primera, 20, and he played for seven different teams in the Honor Division: RCD Espanyol, FCBarcelona, ​​Real Madrid, Atlético de Madrid, Sevilla FC, Zaragoza and Mallorca. programme.title: 30 for 30: Brian and the Boz
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

Cast: Jason Weinberg, Bill Lake, Dennis Akayama, Jerry Mendicino, Hrant Alyanak, Jean-Marc Fontaine, Brendan Wall. Led by: Stephen Bogert, Jonathan Aris. Canada, 2003, documentary

programme.title: d/s Air Crash Investigation (Neglect of preparation)

Cast: Jason Weinberg, Bill Lake, Dennis Akayama, Jerry Mendicino, Hrant Alyanak, Jean-Marc Fontaine, Brendan Wall. Led by: Stephen Bogert, Jonathan Aris. Canada, 2003, documentary

programme.title: d/s Secrets of amazing things (Swamp mummy, Abrams car and bust of Nefertiti)
programme.desc: Remains discovered in pristine condition in a Danish bog are related to a 2,400-year-old murder, or is it something else? Dir.: Corey Johnson. United Kingdom

programme.title: d/s Secrets of amazing things (Roanoke, mouthpiece and beard of the Sphinx)
programme.desc: Could an artifact bearing Elizabethan inscriptions shed light on one of the great mysteries of Colonial America, or is it an elaborate forgery? Dir.: Corey Johnson. United Kingdom

programme.title: d/s Ice Road (Best of the Best)
programme.desc: Bjorn and Tord must assemble a team of 10 people to get an overturned trailer and its valuable cargo back on the road. The trailer has fallen into a deep snow-covered ditch, and the two bosses will have to use all their skills and experience to cope with the task. Dir.: Kelly Neal, Kabe Sponberg, Meidell Olsen. USA, Norway

programme.title: d/s Ice Road (Operation in a snowstorm)
programme.desc: Tord braves the worst snowstorm of the winter to rescue a truck loaded with huge iron pipes, while Thor Steinar risks frostbite while rescuing a trailer truck whose brakes have frozen. Dir.: Kelly Neal, Kabe Sponberg, Meidell Olsen. USA, Norway

programme.title: d/s Ice Road (High stakes)
programme.desc: Tord begins to get nervous when his operation fails even on the third try and time runs out. Bjorn tries to pull a 46-ton truck and trailer out of a deep ditch, but the only thing moving is his own tow truck. Dir.: Kelly Neal, Kabe Sponberg, Meidell Olsen. USA, Norway

programme.title: d/s Ice Road (Road Incident)
programme.desc: Tord's skills are put to the test when he has to come up with creative solutions to get the excavator out. Among other things, Terje's reckless driving ends in disaster. Dir.: Kelly Neal, Kabe Sponberg, Meidell Olsen. USA, Norway

programme.title: d/s Ice Road (Night Pandemonium)
programme.desc: Tord has a terrible night when a salmon truck slides into a ditch. While Tord and Bjorn try to pull him out and save his valuable cargo, newcomer Domenic is sent alone to control the situation on a high-risk section of the road. Dir.: Kelly Neal, Kabe Sponberg, Meidell Olsen. USA, Norway

programme.title: d/s Ice Road (Forces of Nature)
programme.desc: A cold winter has hit Norway. Tord, risking his life, clears the roads of snow even in severe snowstorms. Dir.: Kelly Neal, Kabe Sponberg, Meidell Olsen. USA, Norway

programme.title: d/s Construction errors. 5 s.
programme.desc: In New Orleans, construction of the new Hard Rock Hotel turned into destruction. And in Boston, the Great Tunnel became legendary due to its constant structural and financial failures. Canada

programme.title: d/s Construction errors. 6 p.
programme.desc: Heavy traffic in China is causing dire consequences, with several roads and highways collapsing. And we are studying the crawler crane - a heavyweight in the construction industry. Canada

programme.title: d/s Autopsy of disasters (Three Mile Island, Mont Blanc Tunnel, Sampun shopping center)
programme.desc: What caused the meltdown of the nuclear reactor at Three Mile Island? How did a small truck fire in a tunnel under Mont Blanc turn into a deadly blaze? Why did the seven-story Sampoong department store in South Korea collapse? USA

programme.title: d/s Autopsy of disasters (Apollo 13, MGM Grand, Genoa Bridge)
programme.desc: Why did an explosion occur on board Apollo 13 320,000 kilometers from Earth? What caused the devastating fire that engulfed the MGM Grand Hotel in Las Vegas? Why did the world famous Morandi Bridge in Italy collapse, killing 43 people? USA

programme.title: d/s Weather Mutations (Earth)
programme.desc: As the Earth warms, the frequency and severity of landslides and sinkholes increases, and the greenhouse effect is linked to earthquakes and tsunamis. Dir.: Ryan Marley, Victor Kushmaniuk, Andrew Gregg. Canada

programme.title: d/s Weather mutations (Wind mutations/Tornadoes)
programme.desc: The atmosphere is becoming warmer, and tornadoes are occurring in places unaccustomed to this dangerous phenomenon. Since the 1950s, the number of tornadoes of more than 32 has doubled. Dir.: Ryan Marley, Victor Kushmaniuk, Andrew Gregg. Canada

programme.title: d/s Weather mutations (Thunderstorm mutations)
programme.desc: Warmer weather makes storms less predictable. As temperatures rise, sudden downpours, lightning strikes and storms become more frequent and widespread. Dir.: Ryan Marley, Victor Kushmaniuk, Andrew Gregg. Canada

programme.title: d/s Ice Road (Strength test)

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School: Graduation Day (S3E6). Documentary about nature. England, 2023. S3, Ep6
programme.desc: 2023 г. Год: 2023. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2023. S3, Ep6 «Orangutan Jungle School»…Congratulate the new Orangutan Jungle School graduates, who aren't all spring chickens. Follow the convoy to the release site, where the team bids their friends a poignant farewell, then enjoy raucous celebrations as Molly and Bumi move up a gradeCaptivating documentary series that follows the work of the Nyaru Menteng Orangutan Rescue Centre in Borneo, Indonesia, which is the largest orangutan rehabilitation centre in the world. programme.title: Island of the Monsoon: Life on the Wing (S1E6). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Anglija, 2018. S1, Ep6
programme.desc: 2018 г. Год: 2018. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2018. S1, Ep6 «Island of the Monsoon»…Yala National Park is an avian Eden, home to 215 species of bird. This paradise offers many possibilities for parents who can weather the ever-changing climate. programme.desc: What is behind the behavior of the most dangerous animals on the planet - lions, sharks, brown bears and rhinoceroses? The series explores their rare behaviors, unexpected hunting strategies, and hidden adaptation mechanisms. Through observation and scientific data, it is revealed how these animals survive in extreme conditions. USA

programme.title: d/f Continuing the lineage of giant pandas
programme.desc: How to make two rare giant pandas fall in love with each other and give the world offspring? For the first time in Singapore, experts are taking on the difficult task of helping Kai-Kai and Jia-Jia become parents. Experience a unique behind-the-scenes look at the zoo, where scientists and veterinarians use the latest techniques to create the ideal breeding conditions for these amazing animals. Follow all the stages - from the first meetings to the birth of the cubs, and learn how complex and important this process is for the conservation of an endangered species. Singapore

programme.title: d/s Water world of Komodo Island (Great sailors and convinced homebodies)
programme.desc: The underwater world of Komodo also has its own guardian. The mistress of the ocean depths is the giant manta ray. The life of these creatures is a continuous journey. But while some are in constant motion, others spend their lives literally without moving. Germany

programme.title: d/s Living Nature (Seasons. Palette of colors)
programme.desc: Immerse yourself in the amazing world of living nature, where each season reveals its own unique palette of colors. Russia

programme.title: d/s Living Nature (Mountains. Ancient giants)
programme.desc: Since ancient times, mountains have delighted people with their grandeur, fascinated them with their beauty and inspired awe with their power. This issue talks about how the Earth's mountain ranges were formed and what legends have been born at their foothills for centuries. Russia

programme.title: d/s The most poisonous animals in the world (Forests and meadows)
programme.desc: The venom of the Sydney leucoweb spider can kill an adult in 15 minutes. And in the rain forests of South America, the most feared and respected are the brightly colored reptiles. Australia

programme.title: d/f Monkeys and more: our closest relatives
programme.desc: Travel around the world to learn more about hard-working monkeys and their amazing abilities. Primates, like humans, know how to work tirelessly and enjoy leisure. This documentary project explores what we have in common with these intelligent animals, and how their behavior helps us better understand evolution and our own habits. Dir.: Juan Antonio Rodriguez Llano, Juan Luis Santos. Spain

programme.title: d/s Zog and the heavenly rivers (Drought)
programme.desc: In the heart of the Pantanal in western Brazil - the largest wetland region in the world - lies the kingdom of Zoga, the leader of a troop of howler monkeys. During the rainy season, his house turns into an island. Zog and his relatives have always lived in a rhythm determined by nature. But one day it is broken, and the forest inhabitants face a grueling and long wait for rain. The disappearance of water took everyone by surprise: birds, caimans, monkeys and the real owner of these places - the anaconda Olima. For the first time, the heavenly rivers put Zog's kingdom in danger of extinction. France

programme.title: d/s Zog and the Heavenly Rivers (Time of Water)
programme.desc: The rains were already 40 days late. It was getting hotter day by day. It seemed like it would never rain again. Zog began to consider the sun his enemy, he lost all hope, and his condition began to worry his relatives. The forest was dying without water. For the first time, Zog thought that the end had come for all the inhabitants of the forest crowns. Predators became active and the monkeys' lives were in danger. But finally, the heavenly rivers returned, and life in the rainforest was reborn again. France

programme.title: d/f Guadeloupe: from the peaks to the ocean
programme.desc: Embark on an unforgettable journey through an exotic island where volcanic peaks rise above tropical forests and rivers and waterfalls feed rich flora and fauna. You will get to know unique ecosystems, rare species of animals and plants, as well as the culture and traditions of local residents. Discover the secrets of Guadeloupe - from its inaccessible mountains to endless beaches and mysterious mangrove forests. France

programme.title: d/s Return of the disappeared (Disappearance or return)
programme.desc: The series is about how nature restores balance after human intervention. The story of how Amur tigers, beavers, leopards and other species that were on the verge of extinction began to thrive again. The restoration of ecosystems and the return of extinct species is the result of the joint efforts of scientists, environmental organizations and people who care about preserving our planet. South Korea

programme.title: Animal World Special Forces (Elite Troops)
programme.desc: Discover the most amazing and dangerous representatives of the wild, who have incredible abilities and talents. Get ready for fantastic discoveries! Dir.: Max Serio. USA, Czech Republic

programme.title: d/f Moremi: Kingdom of Hippos
programme.desc: When floods reach the Okavango Delta in Botswana, the hippos return to the Moremi Game Reserve, turning this piece of land into their kingdom. In this unique corner of nature, hippos play a vital role in maintaining the balance of the ecosystem, providing waterways for other animals and keeping many species alive during this difficult period for survival

programme.title: d/f Magic Forest of Spain
programme.desc: 80 kilometers from Madrid, in the heart of Spain, lies a magical corner shrouded in old forest. Here, in one of the most fertile ecosystems on the planet, life is in full swing. We will meet eagles, ferrets, eagle owls, badgers and other amazing animals of this forest

programme.title: d/s Jungle Planet (Butterfly Forest)
programme.desc: The Butterfly Forest in southern Africa is a bizarre maze of trees and shrubs that provides refuge for many endangered species. Here you can meet black and white rhinoceroses, wild dogs and other rare animals. Dir.: Juan Antonio Rodriguez Llano. Spain

programme.title: d/s Jungle Planet (Century Swamps)
programme.desc: 90% of the earth's diversity is found in tropical forests. In a hot, dense and humid jungle. These are the most vital places on the planet. Where the parts of a tirelessly working machine are lubricated with water. Where among the countless diversity of animal life, everyone plays their role. The rainforests of the new world are endlessly surprising. In and beyond the damp shadows, among rushing rivers and lush trees, life is constantly in full swing. Dir.: Juan Antonio Rodriguez Llano. Spain

programme.title: d/f Italy. Through places of wild nature (Mountain monks of Little Tibet)
programme.desc: This episode explores the biological cycle of Apennine chamois, which are found only in the highest mountains of Central Italy. Apennine chamois are an ancient species, but today they are under serious threat

programme.title: d/f Hippo Island
programme.desc: On the beaches of the Bisagos Islands, located off the coast of Guinea-Bissau in the Atlantic, you can find strange footprints. They belong to hippos, animals that usually live in fresh water. For a long time, scientists could not explain why these powerful mammals find themselves far from their usual bodies of water. Spain

programme.title: t/s Wild killers (Tusks and horns)
programme.desc: In this issue we explore nature's deadly weapons - tusks and horns. We learn how elephants and rhinoceroses use them for defense and attack, and how deer and buffalo turn them into formidable means of survival in battles for territory and the right to life. Dir.: Paul Dean. USA

programme.title: d/s Strategies in the wild (Always in touch)
programme.desc: Communication and connection is one of the main strategies of the animal world. And the winners are those animals that are able to use it. Dir.: Max Serio, Bettina Dalton. Czech Republic, USA

programme.title: d/s Sharks. Declaration of love. 2 s.
programme.desc: Sharks are the oldest inhabitants of the ocean, having survived millions of years of evolution and retained their uniqueness to this day. We learn about the different species of sharks, their anatomy, behavior and ecology. Experts will talk about the myths and facts associated with these predators, dispelling many common misconceptions

programme.title: d/f Where the soul lives (Indian elephants)
programme.desc: In this series you will meet the Asian elephant - a symbol of wisdom. China

programme.title: Kieling's Wild World
programme.desc: Researchers are certain: We are currently experiencing the worst species extinction since the end of the dinosaurs. Animal filmmaker Andreas Kieling explores threatened habitats on three continents and speaks to researchers and animal rights activists. \n\nThe island of Madagascar, where Kieling observes ring-tailed lemurs, is almost a continent in itself. The jungle home of this lemur species is threatened by deforestation. In Alaska's Denali National Park, climate change is causing problems for many species - including the last 49 wolves that live and hunt there.

programme.title: Kieling's Wild World

programme.title: Africa's Wild Sides

programme.title: The Tuamotu Islands: natural wonders in the South Seas

programme.title: The Wild Pacific – The Beauty of Life
programme.desc: A sea of ​​records. The Pacific covers a third of the Earth's surface, making it larger than the landmass of all continents and containing half of all water. At up to 11,000 meters, it is the deepest ocean. The fantastic underwater shots by Emmy award-winning cameraman Johnny Friday take you through a parallel universe with rocky cities and their own laws. \n\nIt shows playful sea lions, trusting baby gray whales, dancing schools of sardines and threatening-looking hammerhead sharks. Because the ocean doesn't always live up to its name. It was named the Pacific (“Peaceful Sea”) in November 1520 by its Portuguese explorer Ferdinand Magellan.

programme.title: CUỘC ĐUA KÌ THÚ (PHẦN 37) - THE AMAZING RACE (SEASON 37)
